audit_items.proof_trace: The fee_rate is read directly from on-chain state via `emode_group_registry[emode_group][CoinType].flash_loan().fee_rate()` (market.move:810-811) with no intermediate cache or alternative computation path. The resulting fee is locked into the `FlashLoan` hot potato object at creation (L817) and enforced verbatim at repayment (repay_flash_loan:837: `coin.value() == inner.amount() + fee`). The property `fee == emode_group.flash_loan_fee_rate * amount` holds on all code paths.
